//: User-overridable defaults only. ENFORCED defaults — permissions.defaultMode=acceptEdits (auto-accept edits; other tools still prompt, shift+tab toggles) and includeCoAuthoredBy=false — do NOT belong here: Claude rewrites this user file in place on theme/tui changes and drops keys, and para symlinks it onto the SHARED para-home volume, so anything seeded here gets clobbered for every workspace. They live in /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (highest precedence, never rewritten), written by this template's .paraspace/hooks/provision — para itself knows nothing about Claude.
